claims.summary: The artifact correctly identifies the account-group outer holdout.
The inner splitter preserves groups while stratifying labels across five folds.
TargetEncoder is newly built and fitted on each inner-training slice.
Validation rows use transform rather than fit_transform.
CatBoost fits training Pools and uses validation Pools for early stopping.
Validation AUCs and best rounds are aggregated before final fitting.
A new encoder and final booster fit all outer-training rows.
Outer-test features are transformed once and scored with ROC AUC and average precision.
The artifact presents the visible fit/apply structure but does not disclose that encoders.py and features.py are absent, so complete leakage safety is not established.
